Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Ross Douthat was the writer quoted by Merriam-Webster for the Word of the Day on June 27, 2022. The visible quote on the page clearly attributed the statement to Annie Levin (The New York Observer, 7 Mar. 2022), not Ross Douthat. This error occurred due to a misinterpretation of the text visible in the viewport, where the Planner failed to correctly identify the attribution in the quoted material.
